title: Nancy M NDE 3307
content:
3307: I had a stent placed in my coronary artery to open a severe blockage. The procedure was uneventful. The nurse came in at about 2:00 am to have me stand up for the first time. He told me that if I felt sick or faint to sit back down. I stood by the bed and that was the last thing that I remember. Three people, two men and one woman appeared in the upper left corner of my room. I could not recognize their faces. The men were dressed in suits and the woman had on a coat that came just below her knees. They didn't speak but only were there. It is hard to describe the feeling of coming back to this world. I can only compare it to how a ball must feel if you throw it as hard as you can against a wall. This was the next thing that I was aware of. When I came back, I saw the code team standing around my bed preparing to do what a code team does. The nurse had given me epinephrine and restarted my heart so the team left me alone. I do remember saying, 'What the hell are you all doing in here?' I am a nurse at that hospital and had been on hand for several codes. I was very awake and aware at that moment, but shortly after, things were a blur. The next morning the nurse gave me the monitor strip showing my a systole. I can't remember when I understood who my three visitors were. It wasn't too long because I went to medical records after my first doctor visited to look at the medications I had been given. I had only received the appropriate dose of IV epinephrine. I had not had pain medications for several hours and no sleep medications.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) . My heart had stopped. | Uncertain Surgery-related Clinical death This event followed angioplasty about eighteen hours before.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Less consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Immediately after the experience. I was neither conscious nor alert DURING the experience. | Unconscious.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did your vision differ in any way from n: The beings that appeared to me were in the upper left corner of a small room, but they appeared to be much further away than was physically possible for the layout of the room.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: I didn't hear anything and the room was full of people. I know that they must have been talking, but I heard nothing.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: No | Uncertain The more that I reflect on the experience, it's possible that these beings were standing at the other end of a tunnel and I was to go to them.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: None. | I had so little time with these beings that I don't remember any emotions. I do know that I did not feel threatened or frightened.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe | Everything about the universe Shortly after I returned from the hospital, my husband was going to change the oil in his truck before a trip. I refused to let him do it himself and I called and arranged for a garage to do it. When my husband got home, he told me that if he had done this himself, he never would have found another problem with his old truck that would have left him broken down on the interstate. I have had several things happen after that that are strange, but few with the consequences that the first one would have had.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future | Scenes from the world's future See above.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will | No
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I go to church because I love the songs, but I feel differently about God and organized religion. I can't imagine that God is very happy with some of the things that are done in His name. All that anyone need do is to love their neighbor as themselves. This is my religion now.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I go to church because I love the songs, but I feel differently about God and organized religion. I can't imagine that God is very happy with some of the things that are done in His name. All that anyone need do is to love their neighbor as themselves. This is my religion now. | Yes It is so hard to put my feelings into words. I now live every day with joy. Death was not painful or frightening. The Golden Rule is what I aspire to. I know that I will fall short of this aspiration -- I already have, but I will keep trying.
elements.The experience included: Presence of unearthly beings | Presence of deceased persons
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I am more forgiving. I am less quick to anger. I am more accepting of others. It takes a lot to bother me.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes We had just moved into a home that we had helped to build. My husband, an electrical engineer, had installed some of the wiring. When I came home from the hospital, the light bulbs began blowing out. We were constantly replacing light bulbs. I was certain my husband had messed up the wiring. It checked out okay with the power company and in a few months, I quit blowing out bulbs. I have intuitive abilities that I never had before. I am able to see or feel the spirits of some people who have died. | Yes See above.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The whole experience was meaningful and significant to me. | All parts were good
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I was so excited about having the experience that I quickly shared it with several people. I can't tell you how it affected them, but I can tell you that it has had a very positive effect lately on those that I have shared it with. | Yes As a nurse, I have been very gratified with the response I have gotten from my peers. I have told everyone about my visitors, because I believe that it is such good news. I have found resistance from some of my friends. I feel almost a force between us such as can be experienced when two magnets oppose each other.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes I was familiar with Dr. Raymond Moody's books. I think that it enabled me to understand what I had experienced without fear or too much confusion.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. It was very easy for me to view the experience as real as I had the monitor strip to look at. The vision of the three visitors was as plain several weeks out as it was when I had it.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. I seldom speak of my NDE, but it is in my thoughts several times every day. It has had a huge impact on my life. It has brought some things into my life that are a little difficult to deal with, but I deal with them.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I wish that the experience and the after effects would be more readily accepted in our culture. I spend a lot of time trying to bury my intuition and other abilities that I have now. I fear that others will think that I am crazy if I tell them about some of these after effects.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
